dedupe_keys.name: harmonic evaluation of measurement data harmonic subgroup modell based iec 61000 4 30 tuc eht model

description: Harmonic Evaluation of Measurement Data: Harmonic subgroup Modell based IEC 61000-4-30 (TUC-EHT-Model) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by "Chemnitz University of Technology; Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Information Technology; Professorship of Power Systems and High-Voltage Engineering". Analysis of harmonics and interharmonics in measurement data for evaluating power quality. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Time resolution: 200ms-10 min. Spatial resolution: global. Software: Matlab is used for the realization of our code. But the framework (IEC 61000-4-30) is also implemented in other softwares such as WinPQ.. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is This framework has been implemented in some softwares (e.g. WinPQ), which is not open source, but directly downloadable.. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
